pages.title: Build the Saddle
pages.text: This is the heart of the whole tack room. A vanilla $(item)Saddle$(), a little copper, and a handful of diamonds turns your horse into a proper gear hauler.

pages.title: What It Unlocks
pages.text: Once equipped, the $(item)Upgraded Saddle$() opens five dedicated gear slots: $(thing)Chest$(), $(thing)Hooves$(), $(thing)Medkit$(), $(thing)Stabilizer$(), and $(thing)Hitchpost$(). Most of the mod's equipment starts here.

pages.title: Chest Storage
pages.text: Slide a plain $(item)Chest$() into the chest slot to unlock 27 storage spaces on the horse screen. Empty it before removal unless you want your trail supplies tumbling into the dirt.

pages.title: Ender Chest Option
pages.text: Slot a plain $(item)Ender Chest$() into the chest slot instead and the 27 slots become a window into your personal $(item)Ender Inventory$(). Anything you stash here is shared with every ender chest you own.$(br2)Swapping back to a regular chest or pulling the ender chest out preserves whatever you put in it.

pages.title: Stats Overlay
pages.text: Hold the $(item)Upgraded Saddle$() and look at any horse and a $(thing)Horse Stats$() panel appears above your hotbar.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Gender$() — m or f.$(li)$(thing)Breed$().$(li)$(thing)Speed$() — blocks per second.$(li)$(thing)Jump$() — block height.$(br2)Useful for comparing wild stock before you commit to taming.
